test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: All 25 students of a class stand in a straight line facing north. Amit is 10th from right end and Madhu is 18th from left end. How many students are standing between Amit and Madhur?
solution:
Given: Total Student = 25.

Rank of Amit from the right = 10th.

Rank of Madhur from the Left = 18th.

Rank of Madhur from the right is: 25 - 18 + 1 = 8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98982c9dc3963bb925a21989acf06cbeba2f810297a0e0981819df0f293bdffc.png] 

So, the number of students between Amit and Madhur is:

= Rank of Amit from the right - Rank of Madhur from the right - 1

⇒ 10 - 8 - 1

⇒ 10 - 9 = 1.

So, total **'1'** student are standing between Amit and Madhur.

Hence, the correct answ
er is **"Option 3"**.
